value.rationale: The foundational paper is organized around exact standard-family evaluations, while later work emphasizes algorithms and bounds. Square-page books are a standard cyclic shared-edge family whose compatibility graph is not a trivial product of page choices. The theorem resolves every feasible edge subset, not just the optimum, and reveals a clean split among spine-star, side-star, and middle-transversal regimes. The exact polynomial and maximum-set classification are reusable structural data for this family.
